stepTitle: Suppose we fix the decision threshold for all $$3$$ logistic regression models to be such that we get a FPR of $$0.8$$ when we evaluate our model. In order of most to least preferred, rank each of the models given their ROC curves.
stepBody: Consider the $$3$$ logistic regression models with different features trained on the same dataset. Let the models be denoted $$A, $$ $$B, $$ and $$C$$ respectively, with the corresponding ROC curves for these models shown.##figure5.gif##
